admission_point: after C2 root acceptance and before allocation of any C3 attempt

reproduction.method: Construct C3Harness in a disposable TemporaryDirectory with a valid synthetic ROOT topology chain and the exact operative C1, delegated authorization, candidate seed/templates/manifest, and candidate-source MCP policy.
reproduction.observed_exception: AdmissionError: delegated pin or policy binding drifted

source_observations.observation: C3Harness validates delegated authorization using self.policy and then requires candidate_acceptance_inputs.mcp_method_policy_source to equal the same self.policy path.
validate_delegated_authorization correctly requires the operative policy path to equal the delegated authorization's C1-local mcp_method_policy path/hash.
The lock correctly distinguishes C1-local candidate_acceptance_inputs.mcp_method_policy from the immutable candidate-source mcp_method_policy_source.

finding.title: C3 startup conflates the C1-local operative MCP policy with its candidate-source provenance copy
finding.impact: The candidate rejects every correctly serialized C1 before publishing C3 readiness, so F.C3.O and F.C3.W cannot be launched against an operative candidate and no practical or hardware acceptance can begin.
finding.cost_risk_rationale: The fix is localized to startup binding: use the C1-local policy as the operative broker/authorization input and independently hash/compare the locked candidate-source policy provenance. This preserves default deny and avoids weakening either binding.

required_route: preserve and supersede the current C1 and C2 records
repair the C1-local policy versus candidate-source provenance binding through the stable implementation runner
add and execute the dependency-invalidated constructor regression without rerunning unrelated green IDs
run a fresh C0, create a fresh opaque C1, and run dependency-invalidated C2
allocate C3 only after those gates are green
